name: compliance-skills
description: Deterministic, fully offline AI document checkers for contracts, invoices, tender/bidding documents, foreign-trade documents, three-way match, expense claims, bank reconciliation and ad copy. Every finding quotes the exact source line and can be recomputed from the same input - no model, no network. 合同 / 票据 / 招投标 / 外贸单证 / 三单匹配 / 报销 / 银行对账 / 多家比价 的 AI 核对工具。
